author: Ina Meyer, Roland Lachmayer
name: light-microscopy-data-from-a-parameter-study-on-316l-cucrzr-multi-material-specimens
notes:
This dataset was generated in the context of a parameter study in the paper:
_Supplementary data of “Additive manufacturing of multi-material parts – Influence of process parameters on interfacial characterization of 316L/CuCrZr in laser powder bed fusion"_ 

It includes data of Light microscropy of 7 specimens with the following sample number: 1, 8, 24, 25, 32, 33, 40.

* __Materials:__ 316L (Carpenter Additive) and CuCrZr (Eckart TLS GmbH)
* __PBF-LB Machine:__ Aconity MIDI+ equipped with an integrated Aerosint SPD Recoater V1.0
* __Mounting material:__ AB-Zenopox
* __Grinding machine:__ Struers Tegramin-30
* __Light microscope:__ Olympus BX61 with DP74 camera

![Exemplary light microscopy image of a 316L/CuCrZr multi-material sample (Sample 1)](https://data.uni-hannover.de/de/dataset/b42039da-ced8-4f90-8055-02f4c7c422d6/resource/1b79b228-2cf9-4be2-9ded-9fcdcfca6bce/download/exemplary_light_microscopy_image_sample1.png)
Exemplary light microscopy image of a 316L/CuCrZr multi-material sample (Sample 1)
